scope: Weight-free direct-F16 operator GREEN test including leaf-only dispatch and atomic output; not decoded quality or speed
changes_under_test: computed tensors and views are excluded from direct dispatch and fall back to materialisation
all projection outputs are validated before any output vector is appended
controls: gate off/unset/empty, view fallback, single token, large matrix, mixed F32 fallback, cache bypass and warm hit, invalid arguments, nonfinite F16 and F32 weights, nonfinite second matrix, OCR gate off
